statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease
There is concern for an underlying unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The diagnosis is supported by diagnosis codes I49.9 and I25.10
Cardiac event monitoring CPT 93271 is ordered
The service is for further diagnostic evaluation to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential rhythm disturbances
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on payment being bundled into another covered service
No separate reimbursement is authorized for this procedure
